claims.claim: The song reached number one on the UK singles chart and is presented here on bass.
claims.assessment: Chart table gives UK number one, and the article describes it as their only UK number one.

claims.claim: It is the only My Chemical Romance song to reach number one on the UK singles chart.
claims.assessment: Stated in the commercial performance section, which notes it as their only UK number one.

claims.claim: In the United States it topped the Billboard Modern Rock list while the all-genre Hot 100 placed it lower.
claims.assessment: Chart table gives no. 1 on Modern Rock and no. 9 on the Hot 100. The description deliberately keeps the Hot 100 placing out of the copy so the quiz is not answered in advance.

claims.claim: The single came out on 12 September 2006, six weeks before the album.
claims.assessment: Release section gives 12 September 2006 for the single and 23 October 2006 for the album, which is six weeks later.

claims.claim: It runs five minutes eleven and is played end to end with the note highway in frame.
claims.assessment: Player duration is 5:11, matching the album length given in the infobox.

claims.claim: Requests run on Kick, the same performance streams to Twitch, and Discord hosts number talk.
claims.source: Standing channel practice in existing copy
claims.assessment: House order, Kick then Twitch then Discord, one URL each. No schedule asserted.

claims.claim: Quiz: how high did the song reach on the US Billboard Hot 100? Options 9, 1 and 23.
claims.assessment: Answer A, 9. The description does not print the placing, so the question is a real one.

claims.claim: Artist-wide genres are alternative rock, emo, pop punk and post-hardcore, and this normal long form takes the four long-form genre lists plus Long Form All Genres.
claims.assessment: Artist-level classification used for the whole catalogue. Routing follows the standing rule for normal long forms.

distinct_fact_and_source: The UK number one and the chart split with the US, where the all-genre Hot 100 placed it far below the Modern Rock list. Unused by the other six: 0009 takes the piano intro, 0673 the Hall of Fame listing and Rolling Stone placing, 0068 the Time ranking, 1434 the key change, 1912 the Burbank studio, 2420 the lead single argument. The 2006 MTV Video Music Awards fact was dropped from this package because the live description and the existing creator comment on this same video both already carry it. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Welcome_to_the_Black_Parade
uniqueness_assessment: Zero five-word phrases shared with any other package once the song title itself is set aside, checked against the whole accessible copy corpus. Two earlier drafts were rewritten for this: the first reused the 0009 call-to-action lines word for word, and a "played end to end" phrase collided with 0673.
uncertainties_and_removed_claims: The Hot 100 placing is deliberately absent from the description, so the quiz answer is not printed. Live playlist membership and pin state are taken from the screenshots and the user report, not asserted fresh. Historical screenshots cannot show a live save.
